title: S04T01 - Define review records, reviewer ownership, and separation-of-duty policy
description: Model review requests, review rounds, findings, dispositions, actor identity, commit scope, and policies such as no self-review or required independent audit.
acceptanceCriteria: Published schemas preserve review subject, exact commits/diffs, reviewer, round, findings, decision, timestamps, and linked evidence.
Policy can require an independent reviewer and cannot be bypassed without a durable, scoped force reason.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
